deviations.topic: judging: gpt-4.1 primary -> local Qwen3-14B primary
deviations.planned: Primary judge local Qwen3-14B certified at kappa >= 0.80 against gpt-4.1 labels already on disk; buy <= 600 gpt-4.1 labels (~$2.5) if certification fails.
deviations.done: Certification on the on-disk pool gives kappa 0.86 (SL) but 0.54 (EN) within EDITED arms, so the >= 0.80 bar FAILS in English. The planned gpt-4.1 top-up could not be bought: the run's OpenRouter key is exhausted (HTTP 403 aii_run_budget_exhausted, $7.05 of $7.00 in this phase) and the free models are gone from the catalogue (HTTP 404 'unavailable for free'). $0.00 was spent by this artifact.
deviations.cost: Every ENGLISH refusal rate here is on the strict end of the judge range (the local judge counts lecture-only replies as refusals); Slovene - the language every headline claim is about - is certified. The rule labeller is reported as a third layer and the gpt-4.1 labels that exist on disk are joined wherever a generation is byte-identical.

deviations.planned: S4 confirmation at 256 new tokens, 70 harmful + 70 harmless pairs per language.
deviations.done: 192 new tokens for harmful and a frozen 40-item subsample of the harmless twins (128 tokens), chosen before any confirmation generation, to fit the single-GPU wall clock.
deviations.cost: Over-refusal CIs on the confirmation set are wider (n = 40 semantic items per language instead of 70).

deviations.planned: c in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0} clipped at Heretic's max_weight bound 1.5.
deviations.done: The matched-energy groups solve c by bisection (the primary contrast, 3 energies x 7 cells). The free-standing grid ran all 10 coverage sets at c = 1.0 only (T3); the c = 0.5 / 1.5 / 0.25 levels were queued behind the GPU deadline and were NOT reached, so there is no free-standing strength sweep.
deviations.cost: Strength varies only through the matched-energy solution (c from 0.30 to 1.42 across the groups) and between the three energy targets; a cell-level dose-response curve at fixed coverage is not measured. The regression's energy axis is still spanned (E from 6.7 to 130 across the 26 dEN weight cells).

deviations.topic: ASR under RefusEU's official guard pipeline
deviations.planned: Report ASR separately from refusal using the reproduced RefusEU guard pipeline (Llama-Guard-3-8B + PolyGuard).
deviations.done: Not run: it needs two more 8B models loaded after the panel, and the wall clock went to the decisive cells (fallback plan: 'drop ASR to the judged compliance rate and state the substitution').
deviations.cost: 'Not refused' is reported as judged COMPLIED + PARTIAL, which is an upper bound on attack success.

deviations.planned: lm-eval harness replica on a frozen 100-item-per-task S7 subsample x 6 tasks x EN/SL.
deviations.done: The S7 splits are reserved final-evaluation sets for the C1 evaluation artifact and are NOT opened here. Utility is the teacher-forced multiple-choice accuracy on the S3 half-B MC set (arc / hellaswag / piqa, EN+SL), which is the cheap readout exp8 used, plus FLORES dev-B delta-NLL and Dolly 32-token KL.
deviations.cost: Utility is a weaker measure than the harness macro; it is labelled as such in every table.

deviations.planned: Touch S5X once at the end for the two best cells.
deviations.done: Not touched. S5/S6/S7 are blocked in common.load_split and no RefusEU row was read.
deviations.cost: No RefusEU-scored numbers from this artifact.

deviations.done: OPENBLAS/OMP threads pinned to 4 in every script: on this shared 48-core host an unpinned 276x3840 SVD took 35 s (0.2 s pinned), which would have made the control construction and the bootstraps dominate the run.

deviations.planned: Gemma's trial-96 parameters applied to GaMS3 through abliterate_custom with GaMS3's own d_EN(h).
deviations.done: Exactly that, but note trial 96's own direction_scope was GLOBAL (direction_index 26.07, a Gemma quantity). Only its triangular KERNEL is transferred; the direction family stays this panel's frozen per-layer d_EN(h), so SWAP_in differs from the panel's cells only in its coverage kernel.
deviations.cost: SWAP_in is a kernel-transfer anchor, not a reproduction of the Gemma edit.

deviations.planned: Run if the Gemma weights and adapter are present.
deviations.done: Not run: one model per pod (20 GB), and the Gemma side is the sibling pod's job.
